key_points.evidence_quote: Rather than a normal interview, I use this opportunity to ask Ben about his opinion on a number of different trade ideas, ranging from covered calls to shorting Vick CTPs.

thesis: The speaker argues that selling puts or covered calls is only a reasonable trade if the premium received justifies the asymmetric risk of the short option position relative to the potential loss. The discussion emphasizes that one should not sell options simply because they are willing to buy or hold the underlying stock at a specific price, but rather must evaluate whether the market compensation for the risk taken is sufficient before entering the trade.
